name: Dumbbell Farmer's Walk
steps: Stand between two dumbbells, hinge your hips and bend your knees with a flat back to grip them.
Drive through your feet to stand tall, setting your shoulders down and bracing your core.
Walk forward with crisp, steady steps while holding the dumbbells calmly beside your thighs.
Come to a controlled stop and hinge with bent knees to set both dumbbells down safely.
tips: Take even strides and keep the dumbbells from swinging against your legs.
Keep your chest tall and shoulders level instead of leaning sideways or rounding forward.
